Every code box on these pages runs real R, inside your browser. There's nothing to install. Edit the code, press **Run Code**, and use **Show Hint** and **Show Solution** when you're stuck. Your edits are saved in this browser, so you can come back later.

## The case study

A simulated 12-week RCT: 40 adults (20 F, 20 M) randomized, stratified by sex, to **Protein** or **Placebo** during lower-body resistance training, measured at weeks 0, 6 and 12.

- **Primary outcome**: vastus lateralis CSA (cm²) by panoramic ultrasound, 3 images per visit.
- **Secondary outcomes**: DXA leg lean mass (kg) and leg press 1RM (kg).
- **Missing data**: 3 withdrawals before week 12, 2 missed week-6 visits, 1 unusable image, 1 skipped 1RM.

## Tips

- Pages load R once; the first visit is slow, later ones are faster.
- **Start Over** on any box restores the original code.
- Heavy boxes (bootstraps, power simulations) can take 10–60 seconds. The button shows a spinner while R works.
- Works best in Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari on a laptop. It runs on phones too, just more slowly.
